title: Eisenhower's 1954 treaty with the greys
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Eisenhower's 1954 treaty with the greys, about 1954 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this 19454 idea that like Eisenhower like made a treaty that like the grays could like collect biological specimen, do medical experiments on our population
the Eisenhower story that you know Eisenhower met with the Nordics first and And you know, he met with the grays and the grays made him a better deal
tellings.difference: Adds that Eisenhower met the Nordics first and that the greys offered a better deal. Gives no 1954 date and does not mention specimen collection.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Eisenhower making a 1950s deal with the greys; this telling adds that he met the Nordics first.

as_told.title: Eisenhower meets the Nordics, then makes a deal with the greys

tellings.quote: Oh, you know, Eisenhower or somebody signed a, you know, a contract with the aliens back in the 1950s.
tellings.difference: Vague and dismissive ('Eisenhower or somebody'), with no greys, no deal terms and no exact year.
tellings.link_reason: The same alleged 1950s treaty between Eisenhower and aliens.

tellings.quote: I mean in the lore you have this idea of this Griata treaty where Eisenhower, you know, under the guise of going to the dentist in Palm Springs in 1954 instead
tellings.difference: Names it the Greada treaty and places it at Edwards AFB, with the Palm Springs dentist visit as cover.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the lore that Eisenhower made a treaty with the greys in 1954; this telling gives it as the Greada treaty, reached on the 'dentist trip' to Edwards.

as_told.title: Greada treaty: Eisenhower's 1954 'dentist trip' to Edwards AFB
as_told.place_text: Palm Springs / Edwards Air Force Base, California

related.note: Same alleged Eisenhower meeting with ETs in 1954, but Greer says French documents show it was about stopping nuclear proliferation, not a treaty allowing grey abductions.
